messages:
roxana: Received full pen-test from BlackBox. Priority items: 1) service-account over-broad binding -> RBAC lateral escalation 2) KMS audit sampling off for one ring 3) missing service-to-service auth logs. Need a 1hr remediation + evidence run. Who owns what?

ben: I can own RBAC changes. Plan: minimal role, canary attach, snapshot before/after. Prefer Thu morning.

kai: I'll handle KMS audit exports and key metadata. Need confirmation on timeframe vendor wants (they asked for 21 days around incident).

mira: I'll create a sealed evidence bucket and produce checksums + GPG signatures. Also attach upload commands in README.

opsoncall: Standby for window. Have rollback steps ready: reapply pre-iam snapshot and rollback terraform state.

roxana: Vendor asked for sealed artifacts + operator signatures and a manifest listing capture commands. Proposed window: Thu 2024-09-19 09:00 UTC, 60m. Agree?

ben: Good. RBAC canary plan: 1) export `gcloud projects get-iam-policy` -> pre-iam.json 2) create `infra.min` custom role via terraform 3) attach to svc-infra-canary 4) monitor 20m 5) roll. I'll post tf plan to PR.

kai: KMS commands (examples): GCP: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.serviceName="cloudkms.googleapis.com"' --freshness=21d --format=json > kms-gcp-21d.ndjson` AWS: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2024-08-29 --end-time 2024-09-19 --query Events > kms-aws-21d.json`. I won't rotate or rewrap keys until after evidence capture.

mira: Bucket plan: `gs://redwood-pt-evidence-4319` with uniform access + object versioning + retention lock for 30d. Each file will have `sha256` and a detached GPG signature. README will include capture commands and operator identity.

opsoncall: Add temporary alert: log-based metric for `protoPayload.methodName:SetIamPolicy` and increase in `PERMISSION_DENIED`. If errors > baseline*1.05 for 10m -> rollback.

vendor-bot: BlackBox: will need presigned GET links and vendor PGP key fingerprint to verify signatures. Please include fingerprint in manifest.

roxana: Checklist owners: ben (RBAC PR + pre/post snapshots), kai (KMS exports + keymeta), mira (bucket + checksums + signatures), ops-oncall (rollback + alerts), roxana (vendor coordination). React with :white_check_mark: if set.

ben: :white_check_mark: PR ETA today EOD.

kai: :white_check_mark: starting exports after canary stable.

mira: :white_check_mark: will enable retention and upload scripts.

opsoncall: :white_check_mark: pager ready.

roxana: Thanks all. I'll post the calendar invite and vendor connection info. Keep updates here and paste final manifest link in this thread after upload.
